The issue `proxy isatty` was caused by `rich.file_proxy.FileProxy` not implementing the `isatty()` method, which is used by `rich.console.Console` to determine if the output stream is a terminal.

I have fixed this by adding the `isatty()` method to `rich/file_proxy.py`, delegating the call to the underlying file object (`self.__file.isatty()`).

The fix has been submitted.
